2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18:

20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D survival-horror RPG inspired by *Resident Evil: Zona Cero* / the film, with a zombie outbreak, samples, boss, and leveling.

## Requirements
- Build now, do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Include RPG progression (levels, upgrades, lore, stats).
- Support desktop and mobile (responsive, touch controls).
- Save small JPEG screenshots for verification; read only latest.
- Spanish UI requested implicitly by user language.

## Decisions
- Top-down 2D canvas action-RPG with WASD/mouse, touch D-pad/actions.
- Mission: recover 3 blood samples, kill experiment T-07, reach extraction.
- RPG: XP levels, 3 random upgrade choices per level-up, 3 collectible lore archives, kill/stats summary.
- Atmosphere: flashlight cone, rain, lightning, fog, neon signs, procedural props/decals.
- Static world baked to an offscreen cache; lighting glow layer at half resolution for performance.
- Debug API `window.__ZC` retained for QA (teleport/state/xp/finish/spawnBoss/killBoss).

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` fully rebuilt with title/end overlays, HUD, level-up modal, lore modal, mobile controls and responsive CSS.
- `game.js` complete: world, collision, zombie/boss AI, shooting, reload, medkits, pickups, notes, samples, XP/leveling, win/lose, restart, audio synthesis.
- Verified desktop and mobile layouts, shooting, sample collection, note reading, level-up selection, boss spawn/health bar, win/lose flow, restart, touch D-pad/interact/fire.
- Fixed spawn-inside-building bug (`freeSpot` robust ring scan), enemy start distance (460), HP percentage after max-HP upgrades, boss-bar overlap, note reward text, HUD hiding on end screen, icon/favicon, mobile safe-area/touch-action.

### Active
- Final visual verification of latest build (HP bar/hpText test just returned `"bar": "60%"`; expected 60% after 40 damage).
- No code submitted/committed yet.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload and confirm HUD hp text displays `60%` (percentage fix).
2. Take final desktop/mobile gameplay screenshot after latest changes; verify player visibility, boss bar, title, end overlay.
3. Optionally tune starting enemy proximity if still too punishing.
4. Update README with game description briefly, then finish with one-line notes on assumptions (fictional quarantine sector, touch auto-aim, boss requirement).

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, all CSS, overlays, HUD, modal markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: entire game implementation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: saved verification screenshots.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: project readme (optionally add game description).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: serves static site via runtime default server.

## Important Context
- Game runs at `http://127.0.0.1:3002` from a `python3 -m http.server` tmux session named `zc`.
- Playwright requires `DISPLAY=:99`; Xvfb tmux session `xvfb`.
- Use `playwright-cli resize 1280 800` / `390 844`; `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=x.jpg --type=jpeg`.

- `window.__ZC` API: `state()`, `enemies()`, `boss()`, `teleport(x,y)`, `aimAt(x,y)`, `hurt(n)`, `xp(n)`, `interact()`, `shoot()`, `reload()`, `finish(win)`, `spawnBoss()`, `killBoss()`.

- Latest code passes `node --check game.js`.
- Title overlay no longer has an opaque background color; desktop scene shows through. Mobile title uses a darker gradient for legibility.
- Known design behavior: shooting/boss kills can trigger level-up modal and pause before extraction; player must choose an upgrade to continue.
- Boss spawns when third sample collected; extraction interaction is blocked until `boss.alive` is false.
- Starting player coordinates: `(700,1180)`; nearest initial zombie must be >460 px due spawn fix.

## ZONA CERO — Última señal

Un survival-horror RPG 2D jugable en el navegador, con vista cenital, linterna, lluvia, relámpagos, niebla y estética de distrito en cuarentena.

**Contenido**
- **Misión:** recuperar 3 muestras de sangre, eliminar al experimento **T-07** y alcanzar la extracción.
- **RPG:** XP por enemigos, muestras y archivos; al subir de nivel eliges 1 de 3 mejoras aleatorias (daño, salud, velocidad, munición, botiquín, recarga, puntería).
- **Exploración:** 3 archivos de lore, botiquines, munición, mapa táctico y marcadores de objetivo.
- **Jefe:** T-07 despierta con la tercera muestra y bloquea la extracción hasta ser eliminado.
- **Ambiente:** conos de linterna, farolas parpadeantes, neones, coche policial, ambulancias, cadáveres y decoración procedural.
- **Móvil:** D-pad, botones USAR/REC/FUEGO, apuntado automático y diseño responsive con safe-area.

**Controles de escritorio:** WASD/flechas, ratón apuntar, clic/espacio disparar, E interactuar, R recargar, F botiquín, M sonido.

**Archivos principales**
- `index.html` — estructura, CSS, HUD, overlays y controles táctiles.
- `game.js` — mundo, combate, IA, progresión, audio y render.
- `README.md` — descripción y controles.

**Supuestos aplicados:** sector de cuarentena y personajes originales inspirados en el género (no reproducen literalmente la película), apuntado automático en táctil y el jefe es obligatorio antes de extraer. Las capturas de verificación quedaron en `screenshots/` (ignorado por git).
